title: Chapter 603
paragraphs: Chapter 603
Episode 156. Purification of Chaos (7)
Already, more than two weeks had passed since they entered Lafrarosa. When Jin opened his eyes, he stopped counting how many times he had passed out.
'At least this time I woke up feeling refreshed.'
It was thanks to regaining 10% of his power just before he fell.
In fact, Jin felt not only in his mood, but also in his body, a sense of lightness. The regained aura was naturally infusing strength into his entire body.
"Brother Jin has woken up again."
"It seems he regained some of his power at the last moment, his recovery is definitely faster!"
The brothers approached and handed him the traditional snack of the Myoung Clan, 'Cakto', and water.
"How long has it passed this time?"
"Five hours?"
"Oh, thanks to regaining some of my power, not much time has passed. But, I can't remember very well how I passed out from that creature…"
"You didn't fall from an attack by Chaos, Brother Jin."
When Ban stepped in, the members of the Myoung Clan stood up and respectfully bowed.
They had always shown respect to Ban, but after the last disaster, they were especially respectful.
"The reason Brother Jin lost consciousness was not because of the creature's attack, but because of the resonance with the divine power."
According to Ban's explanation, the reason Jin fainted was due to a sort of 'overload' phenomenon. He couldn't handle her power.
"Just before Brother fell, my energy resonated with you at an excessively fast pace."
The start of the divine power resonance, and the resonance amplified so quickly that even Ban couldn't control it.
All these events occurred regardless of her intention.
"Has this ever happened before?"
"No, it hasn't. From the beginning, even after the Heart of Light formed, the divine power resonance with Brother was not fully achieved."
"Yes, I remember that too."
Jin's Heart of Light was formed when he received a blood transfusion from Ban during the first Lafrarosa training.
Afterwards, he naturally tried the divine power resonance a few times, but unlike other brothers, Jin's Heart of Light didn't react much to Ban's power.
"I've been wondering what the reason could be."
"Even with the Heart of Light, could it be because my body is fundamentally different from the other brothers?"
"I thought so too. Boras also inferred the same. But after seeing the unexpected divine power resonance today, I'm convinced there's another reason."
"What kind...?"
"If we compare it to a vessel, Brother was always full. That's why there was no room for my power to be added."
"That's possible."
"And fundamentally having a different body, you couldn't resonate with the power of the divine brother!"
Boras came between them and said.
Like researchers who have made new discoveries, he was excited, his eyes sparkling.
"But this time, Brother Jin lost all his power, so there was room. Hehe!"
"Brother Boras, what about the physical body?"
"That part is particularly interesting, Brother Jin."
Thud, thud!
Boras quickly pressed various parts of Jin's body with his fingers.

"When you were being eroded by Chaos in Gliak's subspace, you said you felt the divine blood resisting, right? At that time, it's clear that the divine brother's blood caused changes in Brother Jin's body for survival."
"Hmm."

"In other words, it's evolution! And your resonance is completely different from our unique clan way. It's not a resonance between the divine Myoung Clan and the Myoung Clan warriors, but a resonance between the divine Myoung Clan and Jin Runkandel."
"What's the difference?"
"It means we have found a clue to complete the martial art of legend......"
"The martial art of legend?"
Boras's words sounded a bit like a scam, but he couldn't help being intensely curious.
"Hehe, have you ever heard of divine unification, Brother Jin?"
"I've never heard of it before."

"Another divine being that existed before the current divine brother. It's said that Nana, the great warrior of the Myoung Clan... could give all his power to his son, Kaka. Through divine unification."
At that point, the wrestling king 'Baba' nodded proudly. Baba was a descendant of the great Myoung Clan warrior Nana.
"Nana also couldn't give his power to other brothers. Only normal divine resonance was possible. Anyway, Nana's son, Brother Kaka, received all of Nana's power and became the next divine being."
If the succession of power could have continued in this way, the current divine being would have to be Baba, not Ban.
Nana and Kaka were very special cases in the history of the Myoung Clan.
And their story was part of the 'ancient legends' from the perspective of the Myoung Clan. It was no different from the founding myths and heroic epics commonly found in any culture.
"So in my opinion, the divine brother and Brother Jin may have come to use the same martial arts as the great ancestor brothers."
Although it felt a bit like grasping at straws, Jin had only experienced divine unification five hours ago.
In addition, Ban didn't add any other words as if agreeing with Boras's opinion.
"If I could use Brother Ban's power..."
The chaos, which is currently snoring in the training ground, would not be a problem at all.
Not only that, it would be hard to find a rival for Jin in the world.
But things wouldn't be resolved that easily.
"Even if it's a martial art that can actually be implemented, there must be a price to pay. Is there any mention of that?"
"Not specifically. But the side effect was that the Tushin brothers couldn't control the resonance, and Jin brother fainted."
"I see."
"Get ready, Brother Jin. Let's go straight to the training ground."
Ban said, looking at Jin.
He meant to go to the training ground not to challenge Chaos immediately, but to try various attempts about Tushin's unification.
"I understand, Brother Tushin."

Chaos, who was in the middle of a pleasant sleep, suddenly woke up and looked defensive as Jin, who had been knocked out, rushed into the training ground with the Brother Myungwang only five hours later.
[Caak!]
Even though he had won the previous fight, from Chaos's point of view, he was more hostile to Jin, who had stolen 10% of his aura.
As always, Ban killed Chaos's spirit with a single glance.
"Go to the corner and sleep, or play by yourself. Spend your remaining time as you like."
[Knock, Kiing......]
Looking at the back of Chaos, who was trudging to the corner, Jin thought again that he was pitiful.
'He doesn't seem like a bad guy... No, he's the one who was formed from Helluram and Glyceric and took all my power. Damn it, I'm constantly empathizing with him.'
He's pretending to be pitiful......
Even trying to think that way wasn't easy. In fact, Chaos was sitting in the corner, looking at Jin and the Myungwang brothers with rather pitiful eyes.
They were curious about what they were doing. Especially since Jin suddenly became stronger by receiving the power of Tushin and threatened him, he couldn't help but be more nervous.
Anyway, Jin managed to ignore Chaos's gaze and started focusing on Ban.
Woo-woo-woo...!
A moment later, a light was shining in Jin's heart. The other brothers' hearts were as they were.
"As expected by Brother Boras. Certainly, this is a resonance only between me and Brother Jin. I didn't make Tushin's resonance right now."
"Really! Our hearts don't shine, do they? Only the hearts of Brother Tushin and Brother Jin are shining."
The Myungwang brothers looked at the two alternately with fascination. Jin also smiled, feeling the power of Ban rising throughout his body.
'It feels like several times the 10% of the power I've regained. If Chaos doesn't have a secret weapon, I think I can finish it right away.'
On the other hand, he was also anxious. Because he could suddenly faint due to the side effects of Tushin's unification, unrelated to Chaos's attack.
And Ban tilted his head as if he found something strange.
"But it's strange. Why does this phenomenon only occur in the training ground? There was no reaction in the infirmary."
"Didn't Brother Tushin activate something when we came to the training ground?"
"No, I didn't do anything. The resonance started just as I was reflecting on the sensation of fighting with my brother and that thing."
[Keeying, keeyeeing. Kingking.]
At that moment, Chaos let out a desperate cry as if pleading something to Ban.
And Jin intuitively thought that there might be some relationship between him and the Tushin fusion.
'Could it be.'
Ban didn't think the same as Jin, but was bothered by Chaos's cry.
"Brothers Il-tuwang and Il-tuwang, it's more of a hindrance to training than I thought."
"We'll move him to the second training ground immediately."
Baltirok and Lumora immediately approached Chaos with grim faces.
"How dare you interfere with Brother Tushin's training?"
"If it wasn't for your possession of Brother Jin's power, it would be a summary disposition! Follow us."
Chaos had no choice but to follow them, terrified. And Jin quietly watched Chaos stepping out of the training ground powerlessly.
Hoping that his intuition was wrong.
'Ah, damn it.'
Unfortunately, though.
Jin felt the resonance between him and Ban unravel as soon as Chaos left the training ground. The same was true for Ban.
"Brother Tushin, it seems."
"......I felt it too, Brother Jin. Il-tuwang, Il-tuwang brothers, bring that thing back."
As soon as the two brothers brought Chaos back to the training ground, a strong light gathered in Jin's heart again.
"Huh."
"What the hell is going on? Is the resonance between Brother Tushin and Brother Jin related to Chaos!?"
The watching Myungwang brothers scratched their heads in confusion, and Boras was saying this.
"Tushin fusion was realized through Chaos......!"
And Chaos, just as fast as before.
He realized again that he had value to them and smiled unknowingly.
"This guy."
Followed by Ban's words, he turned his gaze while whimpering.
